headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.7240). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 19 studies yielded an effect size of 0.95 (95% CI: 0.87–1.04), indicating no statistically significant association between selenium and breast cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 60.08%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
